title: Deployment malware protection needs implementation or inheritance evidence
remediation: The deployment sponsor and endpoint operator identify the approved malware protection provider for each in-scope workstation and hosted component. Obtain the policy and current coverage record, then record the result of an approved benign detection exercise. If a component lacks coverage, assign its deployment owner to implement the missing protection and retest.

milestones.title: Reconcile the assessed component inventory with approved protection coverage, configuration and detection evidence
